title: Great initially, but it just didn't last very long
text: Great initially, but it just didn't last very long. Took a chance on this non OEM battery due to its pricepoint.  Although it performed well initially, it only lasted 6 months while running once or twice a week on mostly hard tile floors with low pile area rugs.  It needs to be replaced again, but this time-  I'm gonna shop around and see if there might be anything available with warranty coverage.
